# testdata fixtures

Fixtures for `internal/imaging`'s tests (spec §4, §11). Every fixture is either
generated by `testdata/gen/main.go` or produced by one of the documented
commands below, with one documented exception (`onepixel.png`, hand-assembled
— see its row below and the Environment note).

## Fixture list

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ok.jpg`, `ok.png`, `ok.gif` | Tiny (16×16) valid images, one per stdlib decoder, encoded from the same deterministic gradient source image so `tensor_ok_jpg.golden` has one stable source regardless of which decoder produced the bytes. |
| `ok.webp` | Same role, for the webp decoder. **Not** produced by the generator — see [ok.webp](#okwebp) below. |
| `truncated.jpg` | A valid JPEG with its entropy-coded scan data cut off. `image.DecodeConfig` still succeeds (header intact); `image.Decode` fails partway through — exercises `ErrCorrupt`. |
| `bomb.png` | A few-hundred-byte PNG whose `IHDR` declares 30000×30000 pixels. `image.DecodeConfig` reports the gigapixel dimensions without ever touching a real bitmap — exercises the decompression-bomb guard's pre-decode rejection. |
| `onepixel.png` | A real 1×1 PNG (grayscale, bit depth 1). Doubles as the byte-identical asset embedded via `go:embed` in `cmd/imagewarden/validate.go` (task 025/037) — **do not regenerate one copy without the other; they must stay byte-identical.** Currently hand-assembled rather than generator-produced; see the Environment note. |
| `tensor_ok_jpg.golden` | Float32 tensor snapshot (little-endian, `len == 224*224*3`) for `Prepare(ok.jpg, ...)`. Not produced by the generator — see [tensor_ok_jpg.golden](#tensor_ok_jpggolden) below. |

## Regenerating

### Everything except `ok.webp` and `tensor_ok_jpg.golden`

From the `repo/imagewarden/` module root:

```bash
go run testdata/gen/main.go
```

This overwrites `ok.jpg`, `ok.png`, `ok.gif`, `truncated.jpg`, `bomb.png`, and
`onepixel.png`. The generator self-checks `bomb.png` (re-decodes its own
output and asserts the reported dimensions) before writing it, so a bad CRC
fails generation loudly instead of silently breaking the test later.

If you touch `onepixel.png`, re-embed it in `cmd/imagewarden/validate.go` too
(task 025/037) so the two copies stay byte-identical.

### `ok.webp`

The stdlib and `golang.org/x/image/webp` are decode-only — there is no Go
WebP encoder in this module's dependency set. Produce it with `cwebp` (from
`libwebp`) against the freshly generated `ok.png`:

```bash
cwebp -q 90 testdata/ok.png -o testdata/ok.webp
```

(`ffmpeg -i testdata/ok.png testdata/ok.webp` also works if `cwebp` isn't
available.)

**Status: not present.** Neither `cwebp` nor `ffmpeg` was available in the
environment this fixture set was generated in. Run the command above once
either tool is available, then commit `testdata/ok.webp`. Until then, task
007's webp sub-test should `t.Skip` if the file is missing.

### `tensor_ok_jpg.golden`

Generated from the live `Prepare`/`tensorize` code path (task 007), not
hand-written, so the golden always matches the real algorithm:

```bash
go test ./internal/imaging -run TestTensorGolden -update
```

**Status: not present.** `internal/imaging/imaging.go`'s `Prepare` entry point
now exists (added early, alongside task 025, to unblock `cmd/imagewarden`
validate's self-test), but `imaging_test.go` (task 007's golden test) does
not yet. Run the command above once that test exists, then commit
`testdata/tensor_ok_jpg.golden`.

## Environment note

This fixture set was assembled in a sandbox with no usable Go toolchain and
no permission to execute build/run commands, so `testdata/gen/main.go` above
has been written and reviewed but **not run**, and most of the binary
fixtures it produces (`ok.jpg`, `ok.png`, `ok.gif`, `truncated.jpg`,
`bomb.png`) have not been committed yet. Run `go run testdata/gen/main.go` in
an environment with Go available and commit its output, then follow the
`ok.webp` and `tensor_ok_jpg.golden` steps above.

`onepixel.png` is the exception: it was hand-assembled byte-by-byte (PNG
signature + a minimal IHDR/IDAT/IEND, with CRC32/Adler-32 computed via plain
arithmetic) in the same Go-less sandbox, since `cmd/imagewarden/validate.go`
(task 025) needs a real copy to `//go:embed` and cannot wait on Go tooling.
Its exact bytes are byte-identical to `cmd/imagewarden/onepixel.png`. If
`go run testdata/gen/main.go` is ever run for the other fixtures, regenerate
this one too and re-sync the `cmd/imagewarden` copy so the two never
diverge (task 025/037).
